speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have presented with a breast mass; to begin our evaluation, how long have you noticed this lump, and has its size or texture changed recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Cancer.

As a 48-year-old woman with a rapidly growing, painless left breast mass appearing four weeks ago, this presentation is highly suspicious for malignancy. I will order further imaging and a biopsy to confirm the diagnosis.

REQUEST TEST: Mammography, Ultrasound.
REQUEST IMAGES: Breast_Mammogram, Breast_Ultrasound.
